parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Client token used to ensure idempotence of the request.

This value should be generated by the client and must be unique across different requests, with a maximum length of 64 ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** from the API request as the **ClientToken** identifier. The **RequestId** for each API request may differ.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource group to be modified.

You can obtain the region ID by calling the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) interface.

parameters.name: RouteTargetGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the route target group instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-route-target-group --route-target-group-id rtg-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token d7d24a21-f4ba-4454-9173-b30000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --force-delete true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DeleteRouteTargetGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --RouteTargetGroupId 'rtg-xxxx' --ForceDelete true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 'd7d24a21-f4ba-4454-9173-b30000'
